regime_context: Thematic leadership is concentrated in Memory/HBM, which is fading with low durability and no breadth. Cybersecurity and Managed Care show strong trends, high durability, full breadth, and crowding. Financials, Energy, and Staples exhibit durable trends without crowding. The rotation is broad but non-directional. The absolute-trend gate has historically reduced drawdown, but no theme has a predictive edge.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity combines a strong trend (hurst 'trend'), high durability (0.9), and full breadth (1.0), suggesting persistent leadership. Although crowded, the absolute-trend gate supports staying power; overweight is warranted with sizing caution due to crowding.
theses.dissent: Crowding is extreme; any sentiment shift could trigger sharp reversals, and cross-sectional momentum rank has no forward return edge.

falsifier.text: Breadth falls below 0.5 or durability drops below 0.6.

theses.dissent: Financials depend on rate-cycle outcomes that may diverge from AI-focused macro narrative; they could underperform if tech dominates.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The headline leader is fading (val_state 'fading'), with low durability (0.49) and zero breadth, indicating momentum exhaustion despite top rank. An underweight avoids potential shake-out consistent with the risk-control discipline of the absolute-trend gate.
theses.dissent: Memory/HBM could re-accelerate on supply news; rank score remains high and the theme is still eligible (trend gate passed), so underweight risks missing a rebound.

falsifier.text: Durability rises above 0.65 and breadth exceeds 0.5 within 10 days.
